s.en: was rusted into a pile of scrap.

s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 掘地兽跃击失败：
野外刷新 DND 怪物
s.en: Spawn DND monsters in the wild

s.zh: 锈蚀怪、凝胶怪、石化蜥、蝎尾狮、掘地兽、腐尸爬虫会在各自的生态区偶尔刷新，也会以狂暴兽群出现。关闭后不再刷新、也不会以狂暴兽群出现（迷锁地牢的「幽暗地穴」不受影响）；保存设置后立即生效，已经在地图上的怪物不受影响。
s.en: Rust monsters, gelatinous cubes, basilisks, manticores, bulettes and carrion crawlers occasionally spawn in their biomes, and also appear as manhunter packs. When off, they no longer spawn or appear as manhunter packs (the mythal dungeon's "Underdark caverns" are unaffected); takes effect immediately after saving settings, monsters already on the map are unaffected.
